description: Build, test, debug, and secure Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that expose tools, resources, and prompts to AI clients. Use when writing a custom MCP server with the TypeScript or Python SDK, choosing between stdio and Streamable HTTP, validating tool inputs, hardening a local or remote server (Origin checks, localhost binding, OAuth resource-server rules, path and command safety), migrating an older HTTP+SSE or SDK v1 server, or debugging a server with the MCP Inspector. Do not use for configuring or consuming existing MCP servers in a client (that is client configuration), for building non-MCP REST APIs, or for generic agent-skill authoring.
